findings.body: This exclusion treats the current warm-conversation specification as legacy documentation. However, `docs/specs/warm-codex-threads.md:4` marks it confirmed, and lines 25–45 specify the new Forge's SDK-backed workers. It already contains plugin references at lines 154 and 208, and the exclusion allows further references anywhere in that document without failing the test. Item 13 permits these references only in the guide's uninstall section or old Forge material. Restrict the exclusions to genuinely legacy documents so the required test covers current new-Forge documentation.
